says: The tooltips' glyphs, drawn before a fact of a tooltip's band (OrdaenTooltips' `Glyph`, frame.luna's GLYPH_ART): one column of 20 x 20 px cells (32 x 32 texels), each a 16 px glyph 2 px in from its cell's top left with its shadow, in the order of `Glyph`: dmg, spd, arm, blk, alliance, horde, elite, time, the cost's dot (white, tinted with the resource's colour), castNow, castTime, castChan, castNext; then the dot's light and shade alone, drawn untinted over the tinted dot; two rows empty.
origin: Drawn by the design's own glyphs: wow-dev-tools `design/scripts/tooltip-glyphs.mjs <page> dmg spd arm blk alliance horde elite time res castNow castTime castChan castNext resLight` writes a page from theme/tooltips/data.js's GLYPHS, TooltipGlyph.vue's style and TooltipColumns.vue's `.res` (the cost's dot, drawn white, and its light and shade alone); the page shot at 1.6x on black and on white with `design/scripts/shot.mjs --width 400 --height 600 --scale 1.6` (`?bg=black`, `?bg=white`), then matted.
